te: The Fourth Crusade assaults Constantinople. The Byzantine emperor Alexios III Angelos flees from his capital into exile.
dz: 第四次十字军东征袭击君士坦丁堡。拜占庭皇帝阿莱克修斯三世·安杰洛斯逃离首都流亡。
de: The Fourth Crusade assaults Constantinople. The Byzantine emperor Alexios III Angelos flees from his capital into exile.

t: 四岁的亨利四世在亚琛被加冕为德国国王.
te: Four year-old Henry IV is crowned as king of Germany in Aachen.
dz: 四岁的亨利四世在亚琛被加冕为德国国王.
de: Four year-old Henry IV is crowned as king of Germany in Aachen.

t: 达马苏斯二世当选教皇,23天后去世.
te: Damasus II is elected pope, and dies 23 days later.
dz: 达马苏斯二世当选教皇,23天后去世.
de: Damasus II is elected pope, and dies 23 days later.

t: 当年早些时候教宗佩拉吉乌斯一世去世后对教宗约翰三世的封号.
te: Consecration of Pope John III following the death of Pope Pelagius I earlier that year.
dz: 当年早些时候教宗佩拉吉乌斯一世去世后对教宗约翰三世的封号.
de: Consecration of Pope John III following the death of Pope Pelagius I earlier that year.

t: 北非Scillium(今突尼斯Kasserine附近)有12名居民因是基督徒被处决. 这是基督…
te: Twelve inhabitants of Scillium (near Kasserine, modern-day Tunisia) in North Africa are executed for being Christians. …
dz: 北非Scillium(今突尼斯Kasserine附近)有12名居民因是基督徒被处决. 这是基督教在那个地区最早的记录.
de: Twelve inhabitants of Scillium (near Kasserine, modern-day Tunisia) in North Africa are executed for being Christians. This is the earliest record of Christianity in that part of the world.
